sections.markdown:
## C2 — Passing limits, pedestrians, other laws, stops, insurance, tint and move-over

FACT_ID: sec10-F40 | anchor: A66
Before passing, check far enough ahead and behind for drivers about to pass you, and alert the driver ahead with a horn tap, or a headlight flick at night. [A66]
Source: [A66 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec10-F41 | anchor: A66
Signal left before passing and right before moving back, returning only when the passed car's whole front shows in your inside mirror. [A66]
Source: [A66 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec10-F42 | anchor: A66
When someone is passing you, keep to your lane and do not speed up. [A66]
Source: [A66 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec10-F43 | anchor: A66
Passing on the right is allowed on one-way roads and on roads marked for two or more lanes going the same way. [A66]
Source: [A66 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec10-F44 | anchor: A67
Using the shoulder to pass is unlawful except in an emergency or when traffic authorities direct it. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F45 | anchor: A67
A signal alone gives no right to pass on the right; check both ways and watch the car closely, since some states forbid the move. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F46 | anchor: A67
Do not cross the center line to pass on a curve or hill unless you can see a clear passing distance of at least 500 feet. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F47 | anchor: A67
Do not cross the center line to pass at a highway intersection, when meeting oncoming traffic, where signs forbid it, or with a solid yellow line on your side; double solid yellow bars both directions. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F48 | anchor: A67
Watch hardest for pedestrians near parked cars, in darkness, near schools and play areas, and near churches, mailboxes and bus stops. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F49 | anchor: A67
Drivers must stop for school children and safety patrols, yield to blind walkers, keep crosswalks clear while waiting, and stop for a bus with its stop arm out. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F50 | anchor: A67
Pedestrians crossing anywhere other than a crosswalk must yield to all vehicles. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F51 | anchor: A67
Walkers on a roadway keep far left in single file, carry a light or wear light or reflective clothing at night, and make eye contact with drivers. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F52 | anchor: A67
Only vehicles on necessary official business may follow within 500 feet of an emergency vehicle on a run. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F53 | anchor: A67
Never drive over an unprotected fire hose unless a police officer or fire official authorizes it. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-F54 | anchor: A68
Before backing, walk around the car, then look front, sides and rear and keep looking over your right shoulder, not trusting the mirror. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F55 | anchor: A68
Backing is banned on freeways and expressways except for emergency vehicles on duty. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F56 | anchor: A68
Back out of a driveway only into the nearest lane, never across other lanes. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F57 | anchor: A68
Driving on the shoulder is unlawful except in emergency conditions. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F58 | anchor: A68
State law bars any sign, poster or other material that obstructs a vehicle window. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F59 | anchor: A68
Before changing lanes, check clearance beside, ahead and behind, and glance over your shoulder at the blind spot; a signal does not give you the right to move. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F60 | anchor: A68
Hand signals: arm down to stop or slow, arm straight out for a left turn, arm up for a right turn. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F61 | anchor: A69
It is unlawful to drive with a load, or more than three people in the front seat, that blocks the driver's view or control. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec10-F62 | anchor: A69
A load may stick out no more than 5 feet beyond the front and rear of the vehicle. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec10-F63 | anchor: A69
A load reaching 4 feet or more past the rear needs a red flag at least 12 inches square by day and a red light visible for 200 feet at night. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec10-F64 | anchor: A69
When stopped by police, signal and pull off safely, turn off the engine and radio, and stay inside unless told to get out. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec10-F65 | anchor: A69
Keep both hands on the wheel, ask passengers to stay calm with hands visible, put devices down, and turn on interior lights at night. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec10-F66 | anchor: A69
Tell the officer at first contact about any weapons, and do not reach for your license or papers until told to. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec10-F67 | anchor: A69
An officer out of uniform will show credentials, and you may ask to see them. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec10-F68 | anchor: A69
Signing a citation does not admit guilt, but refusing one may get you arrested; contest it in court instead of arguing. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec10-F69 | anchor: A70
If you think an officer acted wrongly, record the time, date, place and details and report it promptly to the officer's agency. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec10-F70 | anchor: A70
At a traffic stop you need your driver license, proof of insurance and vehicle registration. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec10-F71 | anchor: A70
Alabama's Mandatory Liability Insurance Law bars operating or registering a road vehicle without liability insurance. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec10-F72 | anchor: A70
Minimum coverage is $25,000 for one person's injury or death, $50,000 for two or more, and $25,000 for property damage. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec10-F73 | anchor: A70
An insurance violation can bring a fine up to $500 the first time, up to $1,000 after that, and/or a six month suspension. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec10-F74 | anchor: A70
On every vehicle only the top 6 inches of the windshield may be tinted. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec10-F75 | anchor: A70
Passenger car side and rear windows need tint passing at least 32 percent of light; SUVs, trucks, vans and RVs follow that only for front side windows. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec10-F76 | anchor: A70
On roads of four or more lanes, leave the lane next to a stopped emergency vehicle with flashing lights or a wrecker with amber lights. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec10-F77 | anchor: A70
If you cannot move over, slow to at least 15 miles per hour under the limit; on two lanes, move away within your lane and slow 15 under when the limit is 25 or more, or go 10 where it is 20 or less. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec10-F78 | anchor: A68
Aside from backing into a parking space, backing on a public street or road is never advisable, and drivers should follow the same backing rules when pulling out from angle parking into traffic [A68].
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F79 | anchor: A68
Improper turns cause many crashes, and the pedestrian at an intersection is often the one hurt. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-F80 | anchor: A69
If your license, insurance proof or registration is out of reach, tell the officer before you reach for it. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec10-F81 | anchor: A70
On SUVs, trucks, vans and RVs, darker tint is allowed on windows behind the driver. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A64
Amber bus lights mean get ready, with red lights and stop arm meaning stop at least 20 feet away. [A64]
Why it matters: group_hint school-bus; prereq_hint sec10-F22; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec10-F25, sec10-F27.
Source: [A64 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A70
Move-over means leave the adjacent lane on four or more lanes, but only slow down when you cannot change lanes or are on two lanes. [A70]
Why it matters: group_hint move-over; prereq_hint sec10-F21; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec10-F76, sec10-F77.
Source: [A70 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0070]
